column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each chassis/vehicle record.
A VARCHAR(70) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), linking chassis or vehicle details to a specific piece of equipment.
An INTEGER foreign key referencing Transmission(TransRegistry), relating this chassis to its transmission record.
A REAL value measuring the brake pad wear as a percentage of expected lifespan used.
A DECIMAL(5,2) specifying brake fluid level as a percentage.
An INT indicating brake line pressure in kilopascals.
A NUMERIC(7,3) for tracked vehicles, indicating track tension in kilonewtons.
A FLOAT representing wear on the tracks (if applicable) as a percentage.
A NUMERIC(6,1) describing the current suspension height in millimeters.
A REAL number for the vehicle’s current speed in kilometers per hour.
A DECIMAL(9,2) showing the current load (cargo + passengers) in kilograms.
A DECIMAL(6,2) specifying the vehicle’s pitch/tilt angle in degrees.
A NUMERIC(5,1) describing the vehicle’s heading or direction in degrees.
An INTEGER foreign key referencing EngineAndFluids(EngineRegistry), linking the chassis record to engine data.

JSONB column. Captures tire-related data, including pressure, temperature, and tread condition.
Fields: {"pressure_kpa":"A SMALLINT for the tires’ pressure in kilopascals.","temperature_c":"A DOUBLE PRECISION value representing the tires’ temperature in Celsius.","tread_depth_mm":"A DECIMAL(6,2) showing the depth of the tire tread in millimeters."}
